made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/noche-sheet-make.js, from noche-set.html (window.NOCHE.E and E.SEATS) and the design of La noche (the orchestrator's p9-spec, general rules and section noche). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 66. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the back wall at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 66 + 13 v - 22.5 z; the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62. The table's chairs are E.SEATS (FD.setTable's places, with mesa 1): silla1 (0.51, 4.84), silla2 (1.4367, 4.84), silla3 (2.3633, 4.84), silla4 (3.29, 4.84)
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z 0.44: a seat's top; z 0.72: the sofa's right arm's top; z 0.9: the sideboard's top; z 0.74: the table's top; z 1.35: the window's sill) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): the juice, the flan, the cheese, the fruit and the candle have their bottom middle on the spot (the box [sx - floor(w / 2), sy - h, w, h]). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty); the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela sitting mkAbuelaS (52 x 50): column 17 (her middle) and row 36 (her lap) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat; abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30; a grown-up sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 11 a grown-up: 41; t 7 a child: 33) on (sx, sy); a child sitting on the floor (alfombra1, alfombra2 in 105): the sitting drawing with its feet (its lowest row) on the spot; Canelo mkPerro (30 x 22): column 15 and its bottom edge; a small thing: see spot. Whoever lies in the bed (cama1, cama2): the standing sprite hangs DOWN the bed from the spot (the top of his sprite on row sy, his middle on column sx), clipped at the bed's foot (things.cama.foot), and over it a blanket in the bed's colour (things.cama.colour) and the mattress's width (things.cama.blanket) from his chest (sprite row 24 of a child) to the bed's foot. Nobody is drawn turned: whoever sits faces us
rules.lying: the depth of whoever lies in the bed (spots with plane "lying"): the sprite is not an upright plane through the feet but lies on the bed: its pixel at picture row r has the depth of the horizontal plane at the head's height z (the spot's z, .6): depth(r) = ((r + .5 - OY + z * 22.5) / 13) * COS + z / 2, the same for everybody in the bed (two of them tie: the later layer wins). The wall's rim and the floor in front of the arch hide what is outside the hole by the ordinary rule (hidden where bakedZ > depth(r) + bias)
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the table hides the lap and legs of whoever sits behind it, the sofa's seat hides the legs of whoever sits on it, the wall's rim hides what is outside the arch's hole. Whoever lies in the bed: rules.lying.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page for the moment's state). The same rule as El pedido's sheet: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing or sitting on the floor (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28, the dog .3) (open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits on a seat, stands on the sofa's arm, the sideboard, the table or the sill, or lies in the bed (z above 0) casts none: none of those is floor (a shadow cast at the floor under them would show in front of them); the things on the sideboard's and the table's tops cast none
